E0219

A pinned place is moved, replaced, or resized while a pin is still live.

What

A pinned place is moved, replaced, or resized while a pin is still live.

Why

The pin promises that storage keeps its address; moving or replacing it would leave every stored address pointing at the old place.

Fix

Finish using the pin before changing the place, or narrow the pin's scope.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0219: tests/ui/pin_blocks_move.stderr.

Error [E0219]: `node` cannot be moved while it is pinned
  --> tests/ui/pin_blocks_move.jet:12:23
    |
 12 |     taken :: consume(^node)
    |                       ^^^^
 Why: `pinned` pinned `node`, which promises that storage keeps its address; moving or replacing it would leave every stored address pointing at the old place
 Fix: finish using `pinned` before changing `node`, or narrow the pin's scope

Error [E0121]: `node` was given away earlier, so it can't be used here
  --> tests/ui/pin_blocks_move.jet:12:23
    |
 12 |     taken :: consume(^node)
    |                       ^^^^
 Why: after a value moves to another name, the old name no longer gives access to it
 Fix: give away a copy instead (`~node`) where it moved
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0121
